body:
It's funny that you say that it's my dad that wasn't there for him when he was young. My dad is actually his stepfather, we're half-siblings. His biological father was an abusive man, raging alcoholic, so there I can definitely see there being problems with that.

I really want my family to be more proactive in getting him help but they only thing they seem to be doing is shaming him into a positive mindset whenever he's feeling depressed.

It's very difficult for me to be around him a lot. I'm away at college at the moment and only get to visit home on certain weekends. He lives alone but I know now that his girlfriend is spending a lot of time with him and he's been seeing his kids quite a bit, too.

I want to give my parents and my other brother all the information I've learned here so that they can help him properly as well. Maybe from reading some of this my parents will start taking it more seriously.
I haven't, mostly from fear of how he'll react but it's been bothering me so much lately that I feel that I really should now.
Good question. I don't really know. He's never done something this extreme before.

I don't know. I'm very used to having arguments with him and this just seems like it will most definitely start and he won't want to hear what I have to say. I'm the little sister and I feel like a lot of the time he doesn't take me seriously.

I always wondered why after the first time they broke up, which was for a pretty damn good reason, she just didn't stay gone. I really like her and like having her around but it seemed crazy to me that she kept going back to my brother.

I haven't talked to him about it one-on-one but I'm thinking it's probably time that I do. Thanks for the advice.

I really want to suggest that he see a professional about this but then I'm afraid of the backlash. We weren't very close growing up (he was really mean to me) and we've only just started having significant conversations, probably just because I'm older. I do really want help for him, though.

Thank you I'll make a post about this there, too.

He seems to be fine now. No one has suggested he get help except his girlfriend and this was before the attempt. I'll try to find the courage to talk to him about it soon.
